request.style: English, soulful female vocal, warm electric piano, soft bass guitar, gentle drums, subtle strings, deep and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
After John was arrested then
Jesus came into Galilee land
Proclaiming the gospel of God
A message of grace so grand

[Chorus]
The time has been fulfilled he said
The kingdom of God is near
Repent and believe in the gospel
Let your spirit draw close here

[Verse]
He called out to the crowds
Repent and believe in the good news
The kingdom is close at hand
Trust in the words that are true

[Chorus]
The time has been fulfilled he said
The kingdom of God is near
Repent and believe in the gospel
Let your spirit draw close here

[Bridge]
After John was handed over
Jesus walked the dusty road
Proclaiming the good news of God
In the fields of Galilee glow

[Chorus]
The time has been fulfilled he said
The kingdom of God is near
Repent and believe in the gospel
Let your spirit draw close here

[Outro]
The time has been fulfilled
The kingdom of God is near
